Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent ink-wash Three Kingdoms battlefield formation icon, production sprite meant to read instantly at 40–56 screen pixels.
Style for this coherent icon set: bold charcoal ink outlines and broad filled silhouettes, warm ivory and muted ochre cloth, very dark brown/charcoal armour and equipment. Simple slightly rough Chinese brush edges, minimal internal texture, high contrast; no fine faces, eyes, fingers, elaborate armour plates or hair. Three-quarter overhead strategy-game view about 45 degrees, facing screen-right. Recognizable equipment and open negative space between figures matter most. Center the full group including weapons on a square canvas, occupying 82–88% of width/height with clear transparent margin.
Actual transparent alpha background. No paper, scenery, grass, terrain, circle, pedestal, ground shadow, water patch, banner, labels, letters, numbers, decorative border, watermark or UI. No army of dozens/hundreds, no dots or thin grey sketch lines. Deliver ONE isolated group icon only.
